summary: The existing I Part act. baḥoro denotes an examiner; 93/41 supplies finite II mbaḥri with literate human agents and zero-marked books/inscriptions. This adds a stem distribution rather than changing I.1.
The II Infectum is in the scope of an absent-person/purpose construction after layto qaroye and ḥatta d-. It is not a report that examining actually occurred.
Permitted lookup of bḥr 2 verifies mbaḥalle/mbaḥər 'besudeln' with a mud example. Those forms are not imported as an attested Preterit of the research homonym.
Confirm the II research paradigm, particularly its Preterit, and whether it is a productive specialization or a lexical variant of I. The present proposal has one attested 3pl Infectum only.
